text: I'm a childminder with a 3 year old girl staying overnight while her parents are away, and I need to know what to do with her right now. She's got chickenpox, spots all over that she keeps scratching, but up until this evening she was fine in herself. Temp is 39.7. What's bothering me is how she looks when she breathes. Her tummy's pumping in and out really hard, and each time she breathes in there's a hollow pulling in just under her ribcage. Every few breaths she makes a little 'uh' noise at the end, and a couple of times she seemed to stop for a second before starting again. I've looked after a lot of kids with colds and I've not seen it look like this. Her neck isn't the problem, she can look right down at her toes no bother. Do I call an ambulance, take her in myself, or what? I need a clear answer, I'll ring her parents after.
